title: Kneeling Tiefling Sorceress
description: A blue-skinned tiefling woman with curved horns and short dark hair kneels on a cracked black and white checkered floor. She wears a cropped blue top, shorts with garter bows, a long beige and blue coat, and holds a glowing golden hammer in one hand while casting purple arcane energy with the other.
prompt: A blue-skinned tiefling sorceress with ram horns and short dark hair kneels dramatically on a cracked black and white tiled floor inside a gothic stone hall. She wears a cropped blue top, denim-like shorts with blue bows, thigh-high stockings, and a long beige coat with blue accents. One hand grips a glowing golden magical hammer emitting sparks, while the other casts swirling purple arcane energy. Floating ancient spellbooks and glowing runes surround her against a swirling cosmic vortex background with stars and arches.
